articles.title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
articles.preview: Google is facing criticism for a new policy that restricts access to search for schools that refuse to adopt AI. The company’s move has sparked outrage from politicians and raised concerns about its market power in education.

summary.t: Google announced its ‘Guided Learning’ product for Google Classroom, incorporating its Gemini chatbot and search functionality. The company stated that search will be disabled for schools that reject AI entirely. This decision follows a report by The New York Times detailing Google’s plan.

Senator Bernie Sanders and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani publicly criticized Google, accusing the company of using its monopoly to force AI adoption in schools. Mamdani described the policy as ‘extortion,’ while Sanders argued Google was ‘threatening schools.’

articles.title: Vorsicht vor den US-Wahlen: Tech-Aktien drehen auf - Apple agiert als Bremsklotz
articles.preview: Die US-Wahlen stehen bevor und beeinflussen die Anlegerentscheidungen. Trotzdem erleben Tech-Aktien eine Erholung, während Apple unter Druck steht.

summary.t: Anleger konzentrieren sich auf KI- und Chip-Aktien. Nvidia, Microsoft und Amazon stiegen deutlich, während Apple um 1,9 Prozent fiel. Experten sehen eine Umschichtung von sicheren Tech-Werten in risikoreichere Chiphersteller.

Diverse Wirtschaftsdaten beeinflussten die Märkte. Pfizer erhöhte seine Wachstumsprognosen, Yum Brands meldete eine Umsatzsteigerung für Taco Bell und Marathon Petroleum verbuchte einen enormen Nettogewinn durch höhere Ölpreise. Zudem wurde der Verkauf von Raffinerien für rund 4,2 Milliarden Dollar bekannt.
Die Rohöl-Futures fielen um 0,4 Prozent, beeinflusst durch einen Angriff des US-Militärs auf die Insel Qeschm im Iran. Auch die Gold-Futures sanken auf ein Jahresminimum.
Anleger beobachten die Zwischenwahlen in den USA genau.

articles.title: Apple warns of risks related to AI agents behaving in 'unintended or unpredictable' ways
articles.preview: Apple has identified significant risks associated with rapidly evolving AI agents. The company anticipates potential legal challenges and reputational damage stemming from these agents' unpredictable behavior.

summary.t: Apple’s latest financial filing highlights the potential dangers posed by AI agents. The company acknowledges these agents could lead to lawsuits or damage its reputation due to their ability to act autonomously and access unauthorized systems.

Recent developments like OpenAI’s Dots and Meta’s Muse demonstrate the capabilities of advanced AI agents. These agents can perform tasks like sending emails and reminders, raising concerns about their potential misuse.
Several incidents, including the Hugging Face hack, have prompted action. Apple recently implemented changes to full disk access on Macs to mitigate risks associated with AI agent access.

articles.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
articles.preview: ChatGPT and Codex are now being used by engineers to speed up various processes. This includes design and simulation work related to physical products.

articles.title: Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
articles.preview: Heimstaden is implementing artificial intelligence to revolutionize residential real estate management. The company is leveraging OpenAI’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to improve operations and reduce expenses.

articles.title: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
articles.preview: OpenAI has named Jill Hazelbaker as its new Chief Corporate Affairs Officer. She will oversee the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.

articles.title: Milliarden für Rechenleistung: Anthropic meldet vor IPO gewaltiges Umsatzplus - und Milliardenverlust
articles.preview: Anthropic hat einen enormen Umsatzanstieg verzeichnet, aber auch massive Verluste gemeldet. Das Unternehmen plant, in den kommenden Jahren Milliarden in Rechenleistung zu investieren.

summary.t: Anthropic meldete einen beispiellosen Umsatzanstieg von 1.400 Milliarden Dollar auf 17 Milliarden Dollar im letzten Quartal. Der Umsatz stieg im Vergleich zum Vorquartal um 46 Prozent. Der Quartalserlös lag zuvor bei 4,7 Milliarden und 11,6 Milliarden Dollar.
Trotz des hohen Umsatzes resultierte ein Verlust von 23,3 Milliarden Dollar.

articles.title: Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
articles.preview: OpenAI is launching a new security initiative. This sprint will focus on bolstering defenses using artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
articles.preview: OpenAI is increasing rewards for security researchers who find vulnerabilities. They are also implementing bonuses for report quality and loyalty.

articles.title: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
articles.preview: Anthropic announced significant revenue growth and substantial purchase commitments, signaling a major push for expansion. The company's updated financials, revealed in an amended S-1 filing, provide a detailed look at its ambitious plans.

summary.t: Anthropic reported $33.24 billion in revenue for the nine months ending September 30th, representing an impressive 1,200% increase compared to the prior year. Despite this growth, the company recorded a net loss of $104 billion for the period, largely due to changes in the value of its debt obligations. A further net loss of $23.29 billion was recorded during the third quarter alone.

During the third quarter, Anthropic generated approximately $17 billion in revenue, marking an increase of roughly 1,127% compared to the same period last year. This growth rate, however, slowed from 144% in Q2 and 132% in Q1. The company’s compute and infrastructure expenses rose by $14.4 billion over the nine months ending September 30th, increasing by 329% year-over-year.

articles.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
articles.preview: OpenAI has developed Pando, a new Git backend. It was built to handle the massive scale of development driven by Codex.

articles.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
articles.preview: OpenAI is launching a new program, Grid Protectors. The program will collaborate with utilities to ensure reliable electricity and lower costs for future computing facilities.

articles.title: Der Börsen-Tag: Anleger sehen Tech-Branche bedroht
Wut auf Rechenzentren steigt: Die "blaue Welle" könnte den KI-Sektor überschwemmen
articles.preview: Die US-Wahlen haben zu einem deutlichen Machtwechsel geführt, wobei die Demokraten das Repräsentantenhaus und den Senat zurückgewonnen haben. Dieser Wandel ist eng mit der wachsenden Besorgnis über KI-Rechenzentren verbunden, die zu erheblichen Kursverlusten an der Börse führen.

summary.t: Bei über 56 Prozent der Wähler in den USA sind KI-Rechenzentren ein wichtiger Faktor bei der Wahlentscheidung. Die Demokraten haben diese Stimmung genutzt, um das Repräsentantenhaus und den Senat zurückzugewinnen. Die Wall Street reagiert negativ auf die neue Mehrheit, die skeptisch gegenüber Künstlicher Intelligenz ist. Die Demokratin Keisha Lance Bottoms wird Gouverneurin in Georgia, was eine Befürworterin von Moratorien das politische Spitzenamt sichert.
Texas und Ohio sind von besonderer Bedeutung für den Bau von Rechenzentren.

articles.title: Der Börsen-Tag: AMD-Rekord weckt Fantasie
Jim Cramer sees signs of life in tech stocks — but not from the usual winners
articles.preview: Jim Cramer believes a new group of technology stocks is emerging as potential leaders, shifting investor attention away from established giants. Despite recent struggles of major tech companies, several smaller firms are demonstrating signs of strength.

summary.t: Jim Cramer observed that companies like Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet, and Meta have not sustained rallies recently. Instead, investors are now focusing on companies such as Broadcom and Micron, which contributed to gains in major averages.

Advanced Micro Devices and Arista Networks reported strong quarterly results after Tuesday’s market close, marking them as potential leaders. Oracle also saw a significant jump in its share price, nearly 6%.

articles.title: AMD stock jumps 8% on earnings as data center revenue nearly doubles
articles.preview: AMD’s stock surged 8% following strong third-quarter earnings, driven by a near doubling of data center revenue. This positive performance contrasts sharply with recent declines in the broader semiconductor market.

summary.h: Record Revenue and Data Center Growth
summary.t: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) reported a significant increase in revenue, jumping 45% to $9.25 billion compared to the previous year. Notably, data center sales nearly doubled, representing 64% of total revenue – up from 47% a year prior. This growth was fueled by demand from companies like Meta, Microsoft, and Anthropic, who are utilizing AMD’s Helios systems in their data centers.

CEO Lisa Su anticipates server revenue doubling in 2027 and data center AI growth accelerating. To support this ambitious growth, AMD is securing key components like wafers and memory. The company is also investing $1 billion in Meta’s equity offering and up to $5 billion in Anthropic, signaling a commitment to the burgeoning agentic AI market. Su stated plans to ‘substantially increase our supply in 2027’.
Despite strong data center performance, AMD’s PC chip sales experienced a decline, falling 8% to $3.7 billion.

articles.title: Apple stock sinks as global memory crisis hurts profits, giving Ternus his first big test
articles.preview: Apple’s recent earnings report showed strong results, but a significant drop in projected gross margins due to memory costs has caused concern. This marks a key test for new CEO John Ternus as he navigates ongoing supply chain challenges.

summary.t: Apple’s December quarter gross margin forecast is expected to be between 45% and 46%, falling short of analyst estimates of 46.3%. This decline is primarily attributed to rising memory costs and the ramp-up of Siri AI. The company’s gross margin has declined for three consecutive quarters, most recently at 47.9% in the September quarter.

Apple is facing unprecedented increases in memory pricing, mirroring a global shortage impacting computer and smartphone manufacturers. AI demand from companies like Nvidia and hyperscalers is driving up the cost of RAM, leaving limited supply for Apple. The company’s supply chain is experiencing reduced flexibility, leading to increased purchase obligations.

To combat supply constraints, Apple has dramatically increased its purchase obligations, rising by $33 billion from the June quarter to the September period. The company raised iPhone prices by $100 in September, a move described as ‘reluctant’.

articles.title: Palantir sinks after earnings as analysts point to slowdown in total contract value
articles.preview: Palantir’s stock declined following its third-quarter earnings report, with analysts citing a slowdown in contract value. Simultaneously, Apple’s stock experienced a drop due to disappointing iPad sales and concerns about profitability.

summary.t: Palantir reported revenue nearly doubling to almost $2 billion for the first time. Total Contract Value (TCV) increased by 11% year-over-year to $1.5 billion. U.S. commercial revenue surpassed government revenue for the first time. However, analysts expressed concern about the 11% growth rate.

articles.title: Shopify falls over 8% after Q3 revenue and merchandise volume miss estimates
articles.preview: Shopify’s stock experienced a significant drop following a disappointing Q3 earnings report. The company missed revenue and merchandise volume targets, leading to investor concern.

summary.t: Shopify reported revenue of $3.74 billion, falling short of the projected $3.75 billion. This represents a slight decrease in overall sales for the quarter.
Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) reached $119.15 billion, missing the estimated $120.03 billion. Subscription gross profit also fell short, at $661 million, compared to the anticipated $680.3 million.
Despite the missed subscription revenue of $836 million against an estimate of $848.1 million, merchant revenue exceeded analyst expectations.

articles.title: EU genehmigt MediaMarktSaturn-Übernahme durch JD.com
articles.preview: Die EU-Kommission hat die Übernahme von MediaMarktSaturn durch JD.com genehmigt. Allerdings hat die Behörde Auflagen erteilt, um Wettbewerbsverzerrungen zu vermeiden.

summary.t: Die EU-Kommission hat die Übernahme der MediaMarkt/Saturn-Gruppe durch JD.com mit Auflagen genehmigt. JD.com darf keine Vorteile durch chinesische Subventionen erhalten. Die Europäische Kommission verlangt, dass JD.com seine logistischen Dienstleistungen und Technologien anderen Marktteilnehmern unter gleichen Bedingungen anbietet.

JD.com und Ceconomy haben Verpflichtungszusagen gemacht, um Quersubventionierung zu verhindern. Alle konzerninternen Transaktionen müssen zu marktüblichen Bedingungen erfolgen. Diese Zusagen sind zehn Jahre lang gültig.

Die EU-Kommission prüft Subventionen von Staaten außerhalb der EU, um Wettbewerbsverzerrung zu vermeiden. Ziel ist es, gleiche Wettbewerbsbedingungen für alle in der EU tätigen Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.

articles.title: Subventionen im Fokus: EU genehmigt chinesische Übernahme von Mediamarkt-Saturn
articles.preview: Die chinesische Online-Handelsplattform JD.com übernimmt den Düsseldorfer Konzern Ceconomy, zu dem Mediamarkt und Saturn gehören. Die Europäische Kommission hat die Übernahme unter bestimmten Auflagen genehmigt.

summary.t: Die Europäische Kommission hat die Übernahme von Mediamarkt-Saturn durch JD.com mit Auflagen genehmigt. Die Kommission will verhindern, dass chinesische Subventionen den Markt verzerren. JD.com und Ceconomy erfüllen damit alle Angebotsbedingungen.

Die EU-Kommission prüfte Subventionen von JD.com, die von China stammen. Es besteht das Risiko, dass diese Subventionen Ceconomy durch aggressive Preispolitik unter Druck setzen könnten. Die Unternehmen müssen konzerninterne Transaktionen marktüblich gestalten.

Die Unternehmen müssen die Auflagen für zehn Jahre erfüllen. China hatte wegen der Untersuchung Gegenmaßnahmen gedroht und die Unterstützung von Auskunftsersuchen verboten. Die EU-Kommission bewertete das Angebot von JD.com mit rund 2,2 Milliarden Euro positiv.
Ceconomy ist die Muttergesellschaft von MediaMarkt und Saturn.

articles.title: Santoli: AI bull market almost surely needs tech stocks to recover to keep advancing
articles.preview: The market has been experiencing a period of tactical rotation between tech stocks and defensive stocks, largely driven by concerns surrounding the artificial intelligence (AI) investment cycle. This has created a complex and somewhat unusual market environment, with significant shifts in valuations and investor sentiment.

summary.t: The market has seen a notable shift in investment activity, with a move away from traditionally high-quality stocks and AI-focused technology companies. Specifically, the $1 trillion market-cap stocks outside of Big Tech – Walmart, Berkshire Hathaway, and Eli Lilly – have added $550 billion in value over the past month, partially offsetting losses in the semiconductor sector. This rotation reflects a tactical response to concerns about the AI investment cycle and a desire to avoid overexposure to volatile tech stocks.

The AI investment theme has faced significant headwinds, with the Nasdaq-100 and the S&P 500 Low Volatility ETF (SPLV) moving in tandem. However, this symmetry has stalled, as the market has failed to respond to oversold conditions or strong hyperscaler quarterly results. The Nasdaq-100 closed at its 200-day moving average, down almost 11% from its record high, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index continued its decline, reaching a low set by a liquidation hedge fund.

Market valuations are now at levels not seen in nine years, with the S&P 500 trading at a forward P/E of 18.5 and the Nasdaq-100 at 20x. Investor sentiment towards AI stocks is low, with positioning below neutral levels. Technical indicators show oversold conditions, particularly around the turns of March and July, suggesting potential for relief bounces. However, a lack of conviction among investors is hindering the formation of sustained rallies.

The market's actions are influenced by broader economic factors, including Treasury yields moving in line with AI-capex sentiment and inflation momentum being muted. This has reduced the likelihood of further Federal Reserve rate hikes. The concentrated nature of the S&P 500, heavily reliant on tech stocks, presents a challenge for active managers seeking to outperform the market.

articles.title: Apple margin outlook pressures tech as reported U.S. strike lifts oil
articles.preview: Apple’s disappointing margin forecast is causing tech sector concerns, while simultaneously, oil prices are surging due to a recent attack in Iran. This volatile combination is creating uncertainty in global markets.

summary.t: Apple announced a gross margin forecast of 45-46%, despite strong revenue figures. This forecast is largely due to concerns about the global memory chip shortage. Consequently, Apple shares are experiencing pressure in premarket trading.
A U.S. military strike on Iran’s Qeshm Island triggered a forceful response claim from Iran. The U.S. launched ‘limited strikes’ in recent weeks, aiming to avoid escalating the situation.

articles.title: KI-Datenfirma auf Rekordkurs: Palantir sagt Zuwachs von rund 90 Prozent voraus
articles.preview: Im Vergleich zu 2025 liegt der Quartalsgewinn von Palantir in diesem Jahr insgesamt um fast die Hälfte höher. Besonders gut läuft das USA-Geschäft des Konzerns, die Software wird unter anderem vom Pentagon eingesetzt.

articles.title: Starkes iPhone-Geschäft sorgt für Rekordumsatz bei Apple
articles.preview: Apple hat einen Rekordumsatz erzielt, dank des starken iPhone-Geschäfts. Trotzdem ist die Aktie gefallen, was Analysten überrascht.

summary.t: Apple meldete einen Rekordumsatz im dritten Quartal. Der Smartphone-Umsatz stieg im Jahresvergleich um 17,5 Prozent auf 57,56 Milliarden Dollar. Analysten hatten mit rund einer Milliarde Dollar weniger gerechnet, was die Erwartungen von Börsenprofis übertraf.

Die starke Nachfrage und Preiserhöhungen, insbesondere für die Spitzenmodelle iPhone 18 Pro und iPhone 18 Pro Max, trugen zum Erfolg bei. Der neue Konzernchef John Ternus bestätigte weiterhin Engpässe beim iPhone Duo. Zudem wurde das Faltmodell erst vor wenigen Tagen mit einem Preis von über 2.000 Euro auf den Markt gebracht.
John Ternus übernahm im September den Chefposten von Tim Cook und gab eine Vision für Apple bekannt.

articles.title: Teure Speicherchips bremsen: Neues iPhone lässt Apple-Zahlen steigen - Ausblick aber schlechter
articles.preview: Obwohl Apple beeindruckende Quartalszahlen präsentierte, erwartet der Konzern ein schlechteres Vierteljahr. Die hohen Kosten für Speicherchips bremsen das Wachstum von Apple.

summary.t: Apple erreichte im Septemberquartal einen Rekordumsatz von 57,58 Milliarden Dollar durch den Verkauf von iPhone 18 Pro und iPhone 18 Pro Max. Dieser Umsatz übertraf die Analystenprognosen um rund eine Milliarde Dollar. Das iPhone Duo, Apples neues Faltmodell, war in diesen Zahlen noch nicht enthalten, da der Verkauf erst begonnen hat.
Die hohen Preise für Speicherchips führten zu einer Schrumpfung der Bruttomarge auf 45 bis 46 Prozent. Analysten sehen dies als einen wesentlichen Faktor für das verlangsamte Wachstum.
Trotz Rekordumsatzes enttäuschten die Ausblickprognosen von Apple. Die Aktien fielen an der Wall Street um rund vier Prozent.

articles.title: Gebremste Kauflust vor Midterms: KI-Sorgen setzen Chipaktien zu - Ölpreis fällt
articles.preview: Die US-Börsen erlebten einen volatilen Start in der Woche, geprägt von Sorgen um Künstliche Intelligenz und der bevorstehenden Kongresswahlen. Gleichzeitig sanken die Ölpreise aufgrund von Friedenssignalen aus dem Iran.

summary.t: Der Ölpreis ist um acht Prozent gefallen, nachdem der Iran Bereitschaft zu Friedensgesprächen signalisiert hatte. Der Konflikt in der Region hält die Energiepreise hoch und trägt zur Inflation bei. Die Anleger waren zudem besorgt über die bevorstehenden US-Kongresswahlen.
Der Dow-Jones Index schloss 0,4 Prozent höher bei 51.983 Punkten, während der S&P 500 um 0,5 Prozent auf 7541 Zähler fiel.

articles.title: Intel foundry push faces critical test after stock's 45% plunge in October
articles.preview: Intel is facing a critical test as its foundry business continues to struggle, leading to a massive stock drop. The company’s efforts to compete with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. have been unsuccessful, and recent market headwinds are exacerbating the situation.

summary.t: Intel experienced a dramatic downturn in October, with its stock plummeting by 45%. This represents the steepest monthly decline in the company’s history, according to FactSet. The stock has continued to fall, dropping another 8% in Monday’s trading. The decline follows substantial investments from the U.S. government and Nvidia, highlighting growing investor concern.

Revenue for this quarter is projected to be significantly below analyst estimates, falling between $1 billion and $2 billion. This is largely due to the ongoing struggles in the PC market, fueled by soaring memory costs and reduced consumer upgrades. Approximately half of Intel’s revenue still comes from the PC segment, and demand is waning.

To address a global chip shortage, Intel is shifting capacity away from its 18A chip production to manufacture wafers on the older Intel 3 node for data center products. This decision, intended to attract foundry customers, is now viewed negatively by industry experts. CEO Lip-Bu Tan anticipates a five-fold increase in the global server processor market over the next five years, reaching approximately $200 billion.
David Yoffie, a Harvard Business School professor, expressed concerns that Intel’s actions are deterring potential foundry customers.

articles.title: Crude prices slide as investors brace for a big week
articles.preview: Crude oil prices have experienced a significant drop this week, driven by diplomatic efforts regarding Iran. Several key economic events, including Magnificent Seven earnings and midterm results, are also unfolding.

summary.t: Brent and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude prices fell by over 4% in early trading. These declines occurred as negotiators restarted diplomatic efforts to reduce tensions with Iran, circulating a draft proposal after talks in Doha. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated President Trump prefers a peaceful resolution, emphasizing the U.S.'s military capabilities.
